items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: Interviewer mentions 'Teddy's' in the context of a broken tooth and a last time in New York, but the Interviewee does not respond to or acknowledge this specific mention, instead narrating a different story about Bunker and George Mitchell.

ctx.x: Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you.
Thank you. I guess the spring of 47 and had a broken tooth there with Teddy's probably that last time in New York all that was done with the defective set of teeth I betcha

I remember there was one time when Bunker staying at Loft was up later that they got to playing him some jelly roll records and he became very enamored of George Mitchell's playing which he had apparently he had never been aware of how fine Mitchell was and I remember he kept saying how about playing the pearls for me again or what I forget which one it was one of those jelly roll things that Mitchell plays very
